services.title: Celebration Cakes
services.description: From a two-tier birthday cake for 50 guests to an elegant three-tier wedding cake, we design and bake for your special occasion. Every cake includes a free tasting consultation with Lety.

services.title: Corporate Catering
services.description: Impress your team with our continental breakfast platters, lunchtime savoury trays, and afternoon tea boxes, delivered warm to offices across North West.

services.title: Daily Bakery Counter
services.description: Walk in for our famous cheese rolls, cinnamon buns, and classic Victoria sponge. Our counter is stocked fresh from 7am until sold out.

services.title: Custom Cake Consultation
services.description: Sit down with us to plan your dream cake. We’ll guide you through flavours, fillings, and design sketches to bring your idea to life.

testimonials.text: Lety made my daughter's christening cake from a photo I showed her on my phone. It looked exactly as I imagined, and the vanilla sponge was the best I've ever tasted.
testimonials.name: Sarah M.

testimonials.text: We order the corporate breakfast platter every Friday for our team. The pastries are always warm, and the fruit is perfectly ripe. It’s the best part of our workweek.
testimonials.name: David from North West Accounting

faq.question: How far in advance should I order a custom cake?
faq.answer: We recommend 2-3 weeks for standard cakes and at least 6 weeks for wedding cakes. This gives us time for a detailed consultation and to source any special ingredients you request.

faq.question: Do you deliver, and what is your range?
faq.answer: Yes, we deliver all custom cake orders within a 25km radius of our North West bakery. Delivery fees apply, and our driver will carefully set up your cake at the venue.

faq.question: Are your ingredients locally sourced?
faq.answer: As much as possible, yes. We get our eggs from a farm in [Local Area], our butter from a dairy in [Neighbouring Province], and our coffee from a local roaster for our coffee cakes.

additionalSections.title: OUR CUSTOM CAKE JOURNEY
additionalSections.content: It starts with a chat. You’ll sit with Lety to discuss your vision, flipping through our portfolio of past designs. We’ll sketch your idea, recommend flavour combinations like our popular salted caramel & chocolate, and lock in a date. Our bakers then craft your cake in stages—sponge baked and cooled, filled, crumb-coated, and finally decorated with fondant or buttercream. We always schedule a pickup or delivery time with you directly.

additionalSections.title: SEASONAL FLAVOURS
additionalSections.content: Our counter changes with the seasons. In autumn, you’ll find our spiced apple & blackberry crumble cakes and pumpkin spice lattes. Spring brings our lemon drizzle with edible flowers and hot cross buns. We follow the harvest calendar to bring the freshest, most exciting flavours to our North West customers.

team.name: Lety Gibbon
team.role: Owner & Head Baker: The third-generation baker who still tests every new recipe herself.

history: Started in 2012 from Lety Gibbon's home kitchen, using recipes passed down from her grandmother. We opened our dedicated bakery shopfront in [Area of North West] in 2015 to serve our growing local following.
